en.headline: Water supply to three buildings in Jordan interrupted after pipe bursts
en.dek: Water Supplies Department expects drinking water to Highview Terrace and Hong Yuen Court to resume around 6am on Wednesday after a main burst on Tak Shing Street.
body: Drinking-water supply to three residential buildings in Jordan was interrupted on Tuesday afternoon after a fresh-water pipe burst during repair works on Tak Shing Street.

The Water Supplies Department said its staff were repairing a salt-water pipe when a nearby fresh-water main suddenly ruptured inside the work area. Water gushed onto the road. Staff immediately closed the valves and began emergency repairs.
The interruption affected Highview Terrace and Hong Yuen Court, covering three buildings in total. The department said it expected supply to be restored by about 6am on Wednesday.
Residents were advised to make temporary arrangements. The department continued to monitor the situation and would update the public once full service resumed.
No injuries were reported in connection with the burst.

zh.headline: 佐敦德成街食水管爆裂 高景臺及康源閣三座大廈暫停供水
zh.dek: 水務署指維修鹹水管期間食水管突然爆裂，預計周三早上約六時恢復高景臺及康源閣食水供應。
body: 佐敦德成街周二下午發生食水管爆裂，導致附近高景臺及康源閣共三座大廈食水供應暫停。
水務署表示，人員當時正維修一條鹹水管，工程範圍內一條食水管突然爆裂，大量食水湧出路面。署方人員即時關閉水搵並展開緊急搶修。
受影響的是高景臺及康源閣三座大廈。水務署預計食水供應可於周三早上約六時恢復。
署方已提醒受影響居民作臨時安排，並會持續監察情況，待全面恢復後再作公布。
事件中沒有接獲受傷報告。
